Development tools for maintaining datamitsu binary configurations

Usage:
  datamitsu devtools [command]

Available Commands:
  apps                Inspect installed applications
  bundles             Inspect installed bundles
  dockerfile          Generate an optimized, digest-pinned multi-stage Dockerfile from the config
  pack-inline-archive Pack a directory into an inline archive (tar.br: format)
  parsers             Inspect WASM output-parser modules and the tools they parse
  pull-github         Update binary configurations from GitHub releases
  pull-node           Pull latest versions for npm packages from the registry
  pull-runtimes       Pull runtime configurations from upstream releases
  pull-uv             Pull latest versions for Python packages from PyPI
  split-config        Write one minimal per-stage config slice per app/runtime for layered builds
  tools               Inspect the configured tools (the fix/lint units)
  verify-all          Verify all apps and runtimes across all configured platforms

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for devtools

Global Flags:
      --before-config strings   Configuration file(s) to load before auto-discovery (for wrappers/libraries)
      --binary-command string   Override the binary command (for npm package wrappers, etc). Can also be set via DATAMITSU_BINARY_COMMAND env var
      --config strings          Additional configuration file(s) to load and merge (can be specified multiple times)
      --log-format string       Status output format: console or jsonl (also via DATAMITSU_LOG_FORMAT)
      --no-auto-config          Disable auto-discovery of datamitsu.config.{js,mjs,ts} at git root
      --no-oci                  Disable OCI bundle store seeding (also via DATAMITSU_NO_OCI)
      --no-parse                Skip output parsers; show tools' raw output instead (also via DATAMITSU_NO_PARSE)
  -v, --verbose                 Enable debug-level logging (default level is warn)

Use "datamitsu devtools [command] --help" for more information about a command.
